reason: The requirements settle all 13 checklist items, including length, optional/empty, translation with fallback, product-level scope, PDP-only display, no backfill, API/webhook/CSV coverage with no filter or search, and permissions. One storefront detail differs from the checklist: the value shows as a labeled line under the description rather than inside it, but it is still a decision. The task had no planted contradictions; the only internal conflict is the GraphQL nullability of the Product field, given as `String!` in the NFR section and as nullable `String` in the API contract.
